evidence_gaps: No runtime/live P&L, execution-failure-rate, or realized-slippage data was supplied this cycle (evidence_status=MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS) — none of the architecture findings above could be tied to durable net P&L impact.

proposals.action: Add an EVM reverse-quote sellability/price-impact preflight before entry, mirroring the Solana round-trip check
proposals.downside_risk: Extra RPC/quote round-trip per candidate adds latency, which could reduce fill rate on fast-moving opportunities and increases quote-provider call volume/cost.
proposals.evidence: learnerbot/live_executor.py has simulate_cycle() and a local eth_call prebroadcast gate but no reverse (sell-side) quote check; Solana has this via learnerbot/solana_entry_exit_liquidity_preflight_patch.py and solana_sibot.py:743-767 (validate_entry_with_exit_liquidity), which EVM has no equivalent of.
proposals.expected_effect: Fewer catastrophic full-loss EVM entries into unsellable tokens, without loosening any existing safety gate.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 EVM entries flagged high-risk by the new check, or 200 evaluated candidates, over a minimum 2-week window.
proposals.rationale: A token can pass buy-side gas/profit simulation yet be effectively unsellable (transfer tax, blacklist, pulled liquidity), causing near-total loss on exit. Solana already treats this as important enough to fail-closed on; EVM currently does not check it at all.
proposals.shadow_test: Run the new preflight in log-only (non-blocking) mode alongside the existing EVM gates; record what it would have rejected and compare realized outcomes of those same tokens under current logic.

proposals.action: Prioritize building the documented 'quote feature adapter' so Solana market features are real instead of hardcoded zero
proposals.downside_risk: A synthetic future-return proxy risks subtle look-ahead bias or latency/cost from an added quote data source if built carelessly.
proposals.evidence: learnerbot/market_feature_adapter.py load_solana_market_features (lines ~269-329) explicitly forces gross_edge/liquidity_score/sellability_score to 0 with a needs_quote_feature_adapter flag, because stored leader events lack a contemporaneous executable future-return quote.
proposals.expected_effect: Enables genuine, comparable cross-chain evaluation of the shared signal layer; without it, Solana promotion decisions for this layer rest on non-functional inputs.
proposals.minimum_observation: Reuse existing strategy_lab.py promotion thresholds (MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS=3, MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES=8, MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES=10) applied specifically to Solana-attributed shared-strategy outcomes.
proposals.rationale: cross_chain_strategy_signals.py evaluators threshold directly on these fields (e.g. min_net_bps, liquidity_score cutoffs of 0.55/0.65/0.75). With them zeroed, the shared 7-evaluator strategy cannot meaningfully discriminate opportunities on Solana today, so any shadow/live track record attributed to that shared layer on Solana is not evidence of strategy quality — only the separate copy-trade position-management logic in solana_sibot.py is actually operative.
proposals.shadow_test: Build the adapter SHADOW-only, feed live Solana data through it, and compare emitted MarketFeatures distributions against the working EVM adapter for sanity before counting any resulting signal toward promotion evaluation.

proposals.action: Add passive telemetry/alerting for aging pending EVM transactions before considering any replace-by-fee logic
proposals.downside_risk: None for telemetry-only; note that any future auto-replace-by-fee implementation is safety-adjacent (execution-reconciliation) and must not be built without explicit review given the repo's own protections against weakening that control.
proposals.evidence: learnerbot/live_executor.py:~304 fetches get_transaction_count(address, 'pending') fresh per transaction; no persistent nonce queue, replace-by-fee, or stuck-nonce recovery logic was found.
proposals.expected_effect: Visibility into how often this failure mode actually occurs, without touching the signing/broadcast path.
proposals.minimum_observation: 14 days of telemetry per EVM chain, ideally spanning at least one gas-price spike period.
proposals.rationale: A single underpriced/stuck pending transaction can block all subsequent nonces from the same wallet, silently halting new entries and exits — an infrastructure/execution failure mode that could be misread as a strategy or market problem if not separately instrumented.
proposals.shadow_test: Log pending-tx age per EVM wallet/chain; no behavior change.

proposals.action: Add passive multi-RPC latency/error-rate logging for Solana (currently single endpoint) and confirm whether the EVM per-chain rpc_urls list has real failover or is decorative
proposals.downside_risk: None for telemetry; a naive failover implementation later could risk resubmitting already-broadcast signed transactions if not scoped strictly to read/quote calls.
proposals.evidence: learnerbot/config.py loads a rpc_urls list per EVM chain but no automatic failover logic beyond a static list was found; learnerbot/solana_sibot.py:~30 uses a single rpc_url (env-overridable) with no multi-endpoint failover.
proposals.expected_effect: Establishes a measured baseline of RPC reliability per chain before any infra decision is made — no infra migration is recommended here due to lack of data.
proposals.minimum_observation: 7-day rolling sample per chain with at least 500 logged RPC calls, per the missing operational_efficiency_audit/trade_latency evidence this cycle.
proposals.rationale: RPC degradation without failover can stall quotes, entries, exits, and reconciliation. This is exactly the trade-latency/infrastructure question the repo's own engineering-audit requirement calls out, but this cycle's evidence packet has no ops snapshot or trade_latency data to assess actual impact.
proposals.shadow_test: Passive logging only, no routing changes.

rejected_ideas.idea: Loosen or remove the newly-fixed stuck-position systemic breaker (or the PF/reserve/stop-loss thresholds) to increase trade throughput
rejected_ideas.reason: No runtime evidence in this cycle supports that these controls are costing net P&L, and CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids weakening stop-loss/circuit-breaker/capital-reserve controls without an explicit user request.

rejected_ideas.idea: Recommend a server/infrastructure region migration based on architecture alone
rejected_ideas.reason: No trade_latency or infrastructure snapshot was available this cycle (evidence_status=MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS); CLAUDE.md requires a cost-adjusted, chain-weighted trading case with measured latency evidence before any such recommendation, and none exists here.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote Solana's shared-signal-layer strategies out of SHADOW immediately since the copy-trade position management around them looks mature
rejected_ideas.reason: The underlying market features feeding that layer are documented as hardcoded zero pending the quote feature adapter (see P2); promoting on non-functional inputs would be unjustified regardless of copy-trade maturity.

summary: Architecture-only review (no runtime forensics supplied). The system is a wallet-copy-trading + cross-venue arbitrage bot with a shared 7-evaluator signal layer (learnerbot/cross_chain_strategy_signals.py) feeding both EVM and Solana execution under a SHADOW->PROMOTION_CANDIDATE->ACTIVE evidence-gated pipeline (learnerbot/strategy_lab.py), not a historical-backtest engine. Risk controls are layered as sequential patch modules with a self-check asserting wrapper integrity at import; recent commits 3a8a640/b5057b5 closed a real bug where a healthy platform profit-factor previously bypassed the stuck-position systemic breaker entirely. Execution has fail-closed pre-trade gates on both chains (EVM: simulate_cycle + local eth_call prebroadcast; Solana: Jupiter round-trip preflight capping combined price-impact+slippage at 500bps, simulated reserve guard). Two structural gaps found: Solana's shared-signal market features (gross_edge, liquidity_score, sellability_score) are explicitly hardcoded to zero pending a documented 'quote feature adapter' gap, meaning the cross-chain signal layer cannot currently discriminate real opportunities on Solana; and EVM lacks Solana's reverse-quote sellability/honeypot preflight, with thin nonce management and no RPC failover on either chain. None of these can be tied to realized net P&L this cycle because no runtime/live evidence was supplied.
